[[Poison Ground]] is a type of [[environment effect]] terrain that, for 14 seconds, inflicts [[poison]] to players, allies such as the WiK-related allies and their [[pet]]s. Most visual swamps throughout Kryta inflict the Poison Ground environmental effect, but not all of them.

== Locations ==
* [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
** [[Kryta]]
*** [[The Black Curtain]]
*** [[Sanctum Cay]]
*** [[Divinity Coast]]
*** [[Gates of Kryta]]
*** [[Riverside Province]]
*** [[Majesty's Rest]] ?

== Notes ==
* Poison Ground does not have an in-game description.
* Allies summoned via [[Summoning stone]] are immune to this environment effect.
